purpose: Identify the two layouts assigned to Work Views via focus_panel_layout_id. If their layout_key is focus_panel_summary, the assignment points at a Focus Panel surface the Focus Panel runtime never reads, and the picker is offering the wrong class of layout.
combined_query: SELECT id, org_id, entity_type, surface, layout_key, name, status, version, updated_at FROM public.entity_layouts WHERE id IN ('9db0cc6f-cf57-4eb6-b61a-5a877657ec9c','9dedbfad-589f-480f-949c-2c5852d07e7d')
